unit_of_analysis: each scored hoard record (scope 'in' or 'edge', in period c. 200 BCE-136 CE) x each of the 61 entries

components.R_region_0_3: d = great-circle km from record point to each candidate site of the entry (atlas places.json); cp = candidate radius (precision string: '~150 m' -> 0.15 km; 'area ~N km' -> N/2 km); rp = record radius. R=3 if d <= max(0.25, cp) + rp AND rp <= 0.5; R=2 if d <= 3 + cp + rp; R=1 if d <= 20 + cp + rp; else 0. Max over candidates. Candidates without coordinates use stated anchors: jer_shaveh -> Temple Mount point r=3 km; tekoa_herodium -> Herodium (CHRE 7631) r=4 km; jordan_ford -> atlas jericho_area r=5 km. Records without coordinates (H18): R=1 if the entry has a Jericho-region candidate, else 0. Entry 41 (no candidates): R=0.
components.L_landmark_0_2: primary classes only (positional words threshold/corner/wall/pillar/steps/stone are scored under P). L=2 if record and entry share a specific primary class; generic classes {building, court, natural, valley, field} give at most 1; L=1 if they share a family: water {cistern, pit, pool, reservoir, basin, conduit, outlet, spring, pool_adjacent}; underground {cave, fissure, chamber, dovecote, pit}; burial {tomb, monument}; built {court, building, fortress, street}; open {cairn, valley, field, road, mound, ruin, rock, natural}. 'unknown' scores 0.
components.C_container_0_2: entry containers from Hebrew: chest (שדה/שדת), jar (כדין, קלל), pot (דודין), juglet (כוזין). Exact class (chest<->box/pyxis, jar<->jar, pot<->pot, juglet<->juglet) = 2; other closed vessel (jar/pot/juglet/moneybox/box/bowl/lamp/basket vs a different entry container) = 1; no entry container or no record container = 0.
components.K_contents_0_2: silver<->silver coins/bullion = 2; gold<->gold = 2; vessels<->metal vessels = 2; scroll/record<->scrolls = 2; staters<->silver coins = 2; ingots<->silver bullion = 1; amount with unspecified metal<->silver or gold = 1; bronze coins match nothing (0); max over pairs.
components.P_position_0_2: +1 if a structural cue is shared (corner, under_stone, threshold, floor, wall, upper_storey, pillar, steps); +1 more if, in addition, a compass side is shared; +1 if both depths known and record depth / (entry cubits x 0.5 m) within 0.67-1.5. Cap 2.
components.D_date_0_1: 1 if the record's terminal coin date (terminus post quem) <= 70 CE (compatible with a scroll deposited by c. 68 CE); 0 if later (compatible only with late-date hypotheses).

thresholds.worth_testing: S >= 9 AND R = 3 AND L >= 1 AND (C = 2 OR K = 2) AND D = 1

quantity_check_not_scored: entry amount (project English numerals) as mass: talent = 21.3 kg (Lefkovits 2000 p. 473 convention as reported in the repo's inventory_scope_2026-10-06.md); karsh = 10 shekels = 71 g (7.1 g shekel) with an alternative 142 g (14.2 g Tyrian-standard shekel, INFERENCE); karsh applies only to the abbreviated ככ form. Ratio = record mid-mass / entry mass; 'compatible' if 1/3 <= ratio <= 3.
coincidence_test: permute record locations (lat, lon, prec_km) among scored records 2,000 times (seed 20261006); compare observed count of pairs S>=7, max S, and count of 'worth_testing' pairs with the null distribution; also report per-record specificity (number of entries tied at the record's best score).
